description: Eight-task Codex-only regression for prior protocol violations and missing game results.

protocol_override_reasons.backend: local regression uses Docker instead of the official Kubernetes backend
protocol_override_reasons.model: the regression evaluates gpt-5.6-sol instead of the paper model
protocol_override_reasons.reasoning_effort: reasoning effort is pinned explicitly for reproducibility
protocol_override_reasons.timeout: the regression uses a two-hour task budget instead of twelve hours
protocol_override_reasons.attempts_per_task: the regression runs one trajectory per task instead of three
protocol_override_reasons.cell_concurrency: the local controller runs at most two different tasks concurrently
protocol_override_reasons.judge_concurrency: the local shared Judge serializes ephemeral Judge containers
